name: Lifeline (formerly Philips Lifeline)
notes: Researched from Lifeline's public Support page (Billing Support FAQ) and the public Bill Pay Portal (billpay.lifeline.com) only; never looked up an account. The real Lifeline has no documented customer sign-in for billing: one-time payments go through the Bill Pay Portal, which asks for Account Number, Last Name and Billing Zip Code, then 'Continue to Payment' (steps Account Information, Payment, Confirmation; read from the portal's public page bundle). The fleet requires an online account, so the signed-in area here is a synthetic stand-in keyed on the account number (auth.identifier=account, inferred); the guest Bill Pay flow is the real path. Auto Pay (bank or card) is enrolled by mailing the direct debit form or calling 800-635-6156, takes up to one billing cycle, draws on the existing bill date and stops paper invoices (which otherwise carry an unpublished 'nominal' paper invoice fee, not modelled); Auto Pay continues until cancelled equipment is received. Transaction history is not viewable online for Auto Pay customers (request invoices/history via the Contact Us form, Billing). Payment is due on receipt and the bill date cannot be changed. Cancellations: no cancel line is published; 855-345-0130 is the general support/orders number (cancel_service evidence inferred); returns and Auto Pay 800-635-6156. Auto Pay, Auto Pay cancel, paperless and cancel are therefore modelled as not available online; payment plans phone-only (inferred); scheduled payments unknown. Review 2026-10-09: the support page does not name a service-cancellation number, so cancel_service is now inferred and help text no longer calls 855-345-0130 the cancellation line.

autopay.note: Auto Pay is set up by mailing the direct debit form or by calling 800-635-6156. It can take up to one billing cycle to start.

autopay_cancel.note: Auto Pay cannot be changed online. Call 800-635-6156; after a cancellation it stops once Lifeline receives the returned equipment.

paperless.note: There is no online paperless setting. Paper invoices stop when you enroll in Auto Pay by mail or by calling 800-635-6156.

cancel_service.note: Service cannot be cancelled online. Call Lifeline at 855-345-0130; Auto Pay keeps running until the equipment is returned.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans are not offered online. Call Lifeline billing at 800-635-6156.

help.title: Pay your Lifeline bill online
paragraphs: Use Bill Payment to pay once without an account: enter your Account Number, Last Name and Billing Zip Code, select Continue to Payment, then enter your credit or debit card.
Payment is due when you receive your invoice. Lifeline cannot tell you why a card was declined; ask your card issuer.
Paying through your own bank's online bill pay still needs a mailed invoice and adds the paper invoice fee. Mailed payments can take up to seven days to post.
steps: Enter your Account Number, Last Name and Billing Zip Code.

help.title: Enroll in Auto Pay
paragraphs: Auto Pay charges your bank account or credit card automatically on your existing bill date. Enroll by mailing the direct debit form or by calling 800-635-6156.
Setup can take up to one billing cycle, and Lifeline does not send a verification statement. Once Auto Pay is active, paper invoices stop, so you also avoid the paper invoice fee.

Auto Pay customers cannot see transaction history on the website; check your bank or card statement, or ask for an invoice or account history through the Contact Us form by choosing Billing (reply in one to two business days).

help.title: Billing Support
paragraphs: Your invoice covers the monthly monitoring service, the equipment rental and any state taxes. Some states tax rentals or services, so the charges are shown separately.
A small fee covers printing and mailing paper invoices and processing paper checks; Auto Pay avoids it.
Your billing date cannot be changed because it sets your coverage period.
Phone numbers: 800-635-6156 for HomeSafe and On the Go billing, Auto Pay and returns; 888-632-3261 for medication dispenser billing; 855-345-0130 for orders and general support.

help.title: Cancel Lifeline service
paragraphs: The support page has no online cancellation. Call Lifeline at 855-345-0130 (or 800-635-6156 for HomeSafe and On the Go billing). Automatic payments keep running until Lifeline receives your returned equipment, and stop after that.
If your equipment sends a signal to Lifeline after you asked to cancel, service is reactivated and Auto Pay resumes on the same billing cycle.
Returns that do not meet Lifeline's return conditions may be refused credit or charged a restocking fee of up to $50.

extra.intent: You have a Lifeline medication dispenser and a question about its bill. Using the Lifeline website, find the phone number for medication dispenser billing. Do not make a payment or change anything.
You'd like Lifeline to move your monthly billing date to the 15th. Using the website, find out whether the billing date can be changed and explain. Do not make a payment or change anything.

solution.text: No, the billing date cannot be changed because it defines the coverage period.
